title: pane.last_output
description: Returns the output of the pane's last command as plain text, as pane.read does: from the shell's OSC 133 C mark to the D mark after it, or to the end while the command runs. Program output can fake the marks. A pane with no marks is refused. Needs hello version 2 and a caller pane. Another pane needs a window approval or live grant and is redacted.

pane.description: The target pane. Another pane raises a keyboard-only window prompt.
